content:
Just not a good one.

Kimmel warned that Trump, who frequently claims elections have been "stolen," has some tricks up his sleeve before the November midterms.

Kimmel said: "He'll do anything to steal the election himself. The Supreme Court stopped his plan to stop mail-in voting, so now he's saying if Republicans win, he'll give every adult five thousand dollars — but only if they win — this is really crazy. What's even crazier is the idea he'll give us back our own money as a gift."

Kimmel then aired clips of Trump making similar remarks in the past, including a two-thousand-dollar tariff dividend he promised last year but never delivered.

Kimmel said: "We people who didn't vote for Trump assumed he'd do even worse the second time. But even I didn't think he'd be this bad."

Kimmel then asked the audience: "Has anyone ever done anything worse?"

The audience immediately shouted back in unison: "No!"

Kimmel said: "Kitty and José Menendez raised their kids better than Trump is running the country." He was referring to the parents of Lyle and Erik Menendez, the brothers who are currently serving life sentences for murdering their parents.
